verdict.rationale: Gemini API documents adjustable safety settings across 4 filter categories that restrict or allow specific content types, which is a first-party guardrail primitive. The pack shows no standalone moderation endpoint and no documented pattern for gating model output (for example function calls) before it acts, so only part of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: dedicated moderation/classification endpoint, documented output-gating patterns before tool execution, details on blocked-response signals, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the platform gives me guardrail primitives — moderation endpoints, safety settings, or documented patterns for gating model output before it acts

citations.quote: Interfejs Gemini API udostępnia ustawienia bezpieczeństwa, które możesz dostosować na etapie prototypowania
Puedes ajustar estos parámetros en cuatro categorías de filtros para restringir o permitir ciertos tipos de contenido.
Możesz dostosować te ustawienia w 4 kategoriach filtrów, aby ograniczyć lub zezwolić na określone typy treści.
